definition: Any pairing of two colours is classified on two axes: the lightness gap between them, and the saturation of the stronger of the two. Both are ranked relative to the wearer’s own palette, never against a fixed threshold.

terms.name: Bold
terms.description: Far apart in depth, strong in colour. Attention-drawing; worn one at a time.

terms.name: Classic
terms.description: Far apart in depth, quiet in colour. A clear light-dark relationship that reads as deliberate.

terms.name: Rich
terms.description: Close in depth, deep in colour. Reads as depth rather than contrast.

terms.name: Suave
terms.description: Close in depth, soft in colour. Tonal dressing.

note: Because ranking is relative, the same two colours can carry different names for different people. Navy and Dusty Rose is Bold on a Soft Summer palette and Rich on a Cool Summer palette.
